recent_excerpts: Rapid7 expands StarLink partnership across Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, but warns more tech won't fix security ops — teams lack time, context, and specialist capacity.
A Radiant Security webinar examines why WAF, DLP, OT/IoT, dark web, and supply chain alerts are routinely ignored by SOC teams — and how automation can close the gap.
Rapid7's new Cyber GRC platform aims to close the gap between security operations and compliance, addressing the 241-day mean breach lifecycle identified in IBM's 2025 report.
